summary: Candidate is a distinct micro-skill for wrapt-based function wrapping of sync/async method pairs. It differs semantically and technically from peer candidates (decorator-based @operation instrumentation, error logging, agent task execution) and existing skills (image dimension auditing, Flink job execution). No existing skill covers the specific pattern of unified wrapt.wrap_function_wrapper instrumentation across both sync and async variants with identical callback logic. The caution about async context blocking and the constraint on callback compatibility are unique to this wrapping pattern.
